description: Golden-run fixture for SSRAEKmeansSampling (flat, CPU-safe variant) on the micro DANINHAS dataset (2 classes, 25 train + 10 test images per class, generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py). Used by tests/test_golden_run.py to catch integration regressions. See .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 1 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md.
git_commit_note: Regenerated 2026-08-23 on top of this commit, after scripts/make_micro_dataset.py's per-(split, class) sampling seed was fixed to a deterministic hashlib.sha256 derivation (previously Python's per-process-randomized hash((split, class_name))) and utils/data.py's cache_file_path gained a pool_hash component (see the git_commit_note history below and .specs/quality/known-issues.md KI-3). Re-running against any later Phase-1 commit on refactor/phase-1-safety-net should reproduce these values unless a later commit intentionally changes SSRAE/KMeans/micro-dataset-selection behavior.
notes: IMPORTANT — random_state=3 is hardcoded: core/query_strategies/ssrae_kmeans_sampling.py instantiates KMeans(n_clusters=n, random_state=3, n_init=10), completely ignoring the experiment --seed (see .specs/quality/known-issues.md KI-5, .claude/rules/reproducibility.md). The round_1_query_idxs_sorted value above is a function of that literal constant, NOT of --seed 1. If/when Phase 2's seed-propagation audit threads the real seed into this KMeans call, this fixture's query_idxs WILL legitimately change and must be regenerated — that is expected, not a regression.

Verified deterministic across 3 consecutive CPU runs on the local dev notebook (no GPU): identical initial labeled idxs, query idxs, and results.json metrics whether the SSRAE feature cache was cold (first run, computes and writes the keyed cache file below) or warm (subsequent runs reload the cache).

Uses the cache-path fix from this same Phase 1 batch (utils/data.py: cache_file_path helper), extended 2026-08-23 with a pool_hash component keyed on a sha256 digest of the unlabeled-pool ids (see .specs/quality/known-issues.md KI-3), so the golden run reads/writes results/cache/features_ssrae_daninhas_micro_Q13_poola629ae2d049d.pkl, never the pre-existing full-dataset results/features_dict_ssrae.pkl (which must never be touched by this fixture/test).

SSRAE feature extraction runs over the 40 unlabeled pool images (50 pool - 10 initial labeled) at Q=13 (core/tools/SSRAE/extractor.py); the RNN fit itself is deterministic (see tests/test_ssrae_embedding_layout.py docstring), so any run-to-run variation would have to come from KMeans or the ResNet50 training/prediction path, neither of which was observed to vary here.

Initial labeled idxs are identical to the RandomSampling fixture (tests/golden/random_sampling_micro_seed1.json) because both use the same --seed 1 and the same dataset.initialize_labels code path, independent of --strategy_name.

Regenerated 2026-08-23: round_1_query_idxs_sorted changed from [11, 12, 19, 25, 26] to [5, 21, 37, 45, 47] because scripts/make_micro_dataset.py's per-(split, class) sampling seed was fixed from Python's per-process-randomized hash((split, class_name)) to a deterministic hashlib.sha256 derivation, which selects a different (still deterministic) set of files for DATA/daninhas_micro/. This is a dataset-content change, not a regression in SSRAE/KMeans behavior; determinism was re-verified by regenerating DATA/daninhas_micro/ in 2 separate processes (diffing the file-list sha256sum) and by re-running this exact CLI twice (cold and warm SSRAE cache) with bit-identical results both times.
